You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 76385a665ff5cfdf0a6dda43ec9bce7e7d5387d3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2020 15:56:45 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: bcm: Fix pointer cast warning

The NULL check can be done gracefully without cast.  It fixes a
compile warning like:
  sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c:184:6: warning: cast to pointer from integer of different size [-Wint-to-pointer-cast]

Fixes: 88eb404ccc3e ("ASoC: brcm: Add DSL/PON SoC audio driver")
Signed-off-by: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200330135645.9707-1-tiwai@suse.de
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>
---
 sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c b/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
index e46c390683e7..b7a1efc7406e 100644
--- a/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
+++ b/sound/soc/bcm/bcm63xx-pcm-whistler.c
@@ -181,7 +181,7 @@ bcm63xx_pcm_pointer(struct snd_soc_component *component,
 	snd_pcm_uframes_t x;
 	struct bcm63xx_runtime_data *prtd = substream->runtime->private_data;
 
-	if ((void *)prtd->dma_addr_next == NULL)
+	if (!prtd->dma_addr_next)
 		prtd->dma_addr_next = substream->runtime->dma_addr;
 
 	x = bytes_to_frames(substream->runtime,
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a pointer cast warning that occurred due to the improper casting of an integer to a pointer type. Specifically, the code was checking if the `dma_addr_next` field of the `prtd` structure was NULL by casting it to a void pointer, which led to a warning about casting an integer of different size to a pointer. The patch corrected this by directly checking the pointer without the cast, thus eliminating the warning and ensuring proper type safety.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was a pointer cast warning that occurred due to the improper casting of an integer to a pointer type. Specifically, the code was checking if the `dma_addr_next` field of the `prtd` structure was NULL by casting it to a void pointer, which led to a warning about casting an integer of different size to a pointer. The patch corrected this by directly checking the pointer without the cast, thus eliminating the warning and ensuring proper type safety.
